name: Development application
goal: Catch missing documents and information when the application is submitted, not days later.

assistant.greeting: Hi, I can help you get your housing application right first time. Ask me about any document or step.

answers.reply: A BASIX certificate shows your home meets NSW energy and water targets. Get it from the BASIX website. The dwelling type, floor area and number of bedrooms must match your plans.
Every owner on the title must sign owner's consent. If the land is owned by a company, a director must sign and give the ACN.
If your land is mapped as bush fire prone, you need a bushfire assessment report with a BAL rating. We've checked your address against the map.
The Statement of Environmental Effects explains how your proposal meets the planning controls and what impacts it has, such as privacy, overshadowing and traffic.
If everything is complete when you lodge, a reviewer can start assessing it straight away, with no 7-day request for more information.

assistant.fallback: In the real app I'd answer that from the council's lodgement checklist. For now, try asking about BASIX, owner's consent, bushfire or the Statement of Environmental Effects.

steps.label: About your project
steps.goal: Tell us where you're building and what, so we know which documents your site needs.

fields.label: Lot and DP
fields.hint: From your title, e.g. Lot 12 DP 1045678

fields.label: Are you the only owner of the land?
fields.hint: If not, every owner must sign consent

sample.Describe the proposal: Demolish the existing single-storey house and build an attached two-storey dual occupancy, each with three bedrooms and a double garage. One street tree near the driveway to be removed.

steps.label: Upload your documents
steps.goal: Add your documents. Each one is checked the moment you add it, not 3 to 5 days later.

checklist.name: Architectural plans
checklist.check: Site, floor, elevations and sections, drawn to scale with a north point
checklist.sample: The elevations are a phone photo and can't be read at scale

checklist.name: Survey plan
checklist.check: By a registered surveyor, showing levels and boundaries
checklist.sample: The survey is from 2009 and doesn't show the existing house

checklist.name: Statement of Environmental Effects
checklist.check: Addresses the planning controls for this zone
checklist.sample: It doesn't cover privacy or overshadowing for the neighbours
checklist.human: Read the new privacy and overshadowing section

checklist.name: BASIX certificate
checklist.check: Matches the plans: dwelling type, floor area and bedrooms
checklist.sample: BASIX says 4 bedrooms per dwelling; the plans show 3

checklist.name: Owner's consent
checklist.check: Signed by every owner on the title
checklist.sample: Only one of the two owners on the title has signed
checklist.human: Check the second owner's signature against the title

checklist.name: Cost of works estimate
checklist.check: Matches the cost in your application
checklist.sample: The estimate says $980,000; your application says ${Estimated cost of works ($)}

checklist.name: Stormwater concept plan
checklist.check: Shows where the water drains to

checklist.name: Arborist report
checklist.why: Needed because you're removing a tree
checklist.sample: It doesn't cover the street tree near the driveway
checklist.human: Confirm the street tree is the council's to remove

checklist.name: Bushfire assessment report
checklist.why: Needed because {Site address} is on the bush fire prone land map

steps.label: Fix and lodge
steps.goal: Here's what's still missing or needs fixing, in plain words. Fix it here, then lodge.

steps.label: Reviewer check
steps.goal: The application arrives complete, with a summary of what the checks passed and what needs a human look.

config.confirmText: The applicant will get 7 days to fix what you've noted. The checks above all passed, so say what still needs changing.
